122278.d: Reduces all damage you take by 20% to 50% for 10 sec, with larger attacks being reduced by more.

122783.d: Reduces magic damage you take by 60% for 6 sec, and transfers all currently active harmful magical effects on you back to their original caster if possible.

122783.d: 6초 동안 자신이 받는 마법 피해가 60%만큼 감소하고, 가능할 경우 현재 자신에게 활성화된 모든 해로운 마법 효과를 시전한 대상에게 되돌려줍니다.

note: There is no spec-specific source for each raid boss, so these are general principles written by matching ability tooltips to boss mechanics.
